items.title: Kerala’s introduction of generic drug for SMA sparks safety vs affordability debate
items.summary: In an unusual move, three former health ministers of Kerala and Communist Party of India (Marxist) leaders - Veena George, KK Shailaja and PK Sreemati -convened a press meet on Thursday, October 22. All three raised their concerns over use of a generic medicine for patients of Spinal muscular atrophy (SMA), a genetic condition that causes progressive loss of muscle strength, coordination and mobility. Former Health Minister Veena alleged that children with SMA were subjected to clinical trials. The ongoing controversy over replacing Switzerland-based Roche’s SMA drug Evrysdi (Risdiplam) with its generic version, Natsmart, manufactured by Indian firm Natco Pharma, is raising challenges for Kerala United Against Rare Diseases (KARE) scheme, state’s pioneering initiative under which Rs 30 crore is allocated annually for the free treatment of SMA patients. While public health experts and organisations such as Indian Medical Associations are rallying behind the much affordable generic drug, a section of parents of SMA patients and opposition parties are demanding a proper study before distribution of the medicines to the patients. items.title: Chikkamagaluru police book BJP leader after viral video shows him firing gun
items.summary: A BJP leader has been booked by the Chikkamaglur district police after a video of him firing five rounds of bullets in the air went viral online. Jeevan, president of the BJP Yuva Morcha in Chikkamagaluru district, allegedly fired five rounds into the air in a residential area of the city’s Kote locality during Ayudha Puja. Jeevan used a double-barrel gun and a revolver to fire five rounds into the air. Following the circulation of the video, police registered a suo motu case against Jeevan, taking note of the seriousness of the incident. TV media have carried pictures of Jeevan photographed with state BJP president BY Vijayendra and other leaders such as CT Ravi. Firing in Chamarajanagar In a separate incident, Congress leader Kabballi Mahesh, a former vice-president of the Chamarajanagar Zilla Panchayat, was accused of firing a gun into the air during Ayudha Puja at Kabballi village in Gundlupet taluk of Chamarajanagar district. A video showing Mahesh firing into the air after performing puja for vehicles went viral on social media.
